full_prompt_en: A square presentation of a horizontal abstract painting shows a densely layered field of broken black, ocher, orange, blue-gray, and cream marks on a warm pale ground. The actual painted rectangle sits centrally within a clean white margin, its long horizontal edges clearly visible. Inside the rectangle, there is no single figure or architectural subject. Irregular dark marks cluster at the upper left and across the middle, some like short heavy calligraphic strokes and others like torn silhouettes. Mustard yellow and burnt orange occupy small patches between them, with a stronger orange run near the upper right and another warmer cluster near the lower center. Blue-gray strokes interrupt the warmth at the center and right, while pale cream and off-white gaps thread throughout the composition. The surface appears scraped, overpainted, and reworked. Thin black lines, broad dry swipes, small opaque blocks, and translucent rubbed areas overlap at different depths. Some underlayers remain visible through later marks, creating an uneven patchwork rather than a flat mosaic. The lower band is slightly earthier, with tan, olive, and dark brown fragments gathered close to the bottom edge. Dark marks recur across the full width but never form a continuous border; the eye is kept moving through alternating dense and open passages. Light is even across the presentation, so contrast is created by pigment value and texture rather than a depicted light source. The surrounding white margin separates the art from the page and emphasizes the rough, active interior. The composition feels improvisational yet balanced: black accents pull the scattered colors together, while exposed pale areas keep the dense painted field breathable. Its energy lies in layered material, interrupted contours, and the rhythm of marks across a long rectangle.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形展示画面把一张横向抽象画置于中央，画中暖浅色底上密密叠着断续黑、赭黄、橙、蓝灰与奶油色笔迹。真正的绘画矩形居于干净白边之间，长横边清晰可见。矩形内部没有单一人物或建筑主题。不规则暗笔迹聚在左上与中部，有的像短而厚的书写笔划，有的像撕裂剪影。芥黄与焦橙占据暗笔之间的小块，右上有较强橙色延伸，下中部还有一簇更暖色。蓝灰笔迹从中央和右侧打断暖色，浅奶油与灰白空隙贯穿构图。表面看起来经过刮擦、覆盖与反复修改。细黑线、宽阔干笔、细小不透明块和半透明擦磨区在不同深度交叠。有些底层仍从后来笔迹中透出，形成不匀的拼缀，而非平面马赛克。下方色带略偏土色，棕褐、橄榄和深棕碎块靠近底边聚集。暗笔迹反复出现在全幅，却不形成连续边框；视线在密集与开放区域之间游走。展示光线全幅均匀，对比来自颜料明度和肌理，而非画中的光源。周围白边把画作与页面分开，突出粗粝活跃的内部。构图即兴却有平衡：黑色重点把散落彩色联在一起，露出的浅色区又让浓密画面有呼吸。能量来自层叠材料、中断轮廓和横长矩形中笔迹的节奏。
style_prompt_en: Abstract painting accumulates opaque blocks, translucent rubbed layers, dry swipes, fine lines, and scraped interruptions on a warm pale ground. Black accents recur across the field, tying scattered mustard, burnt orange, blue-gray, cream, and muted olive together. Edges alternate between torn sharpness and worn softness; underpainting remains visible where later pigment thins. Dense clusters are separated by exposed pale gaps, so the surface stays active without becoming uniform noise. No pictorial light source is needed, because value contrast and pigment opacity establish the visual hierarchy. A long horizontal rhythm of small and medium marks keeps attention moving through the layered texture.
style_prompt_zh: 抽象绘画在暖浅底色上积累不透明块、半透明擦磨层、干刷痕、细线与刮开的间断。黑色重点在画域中反复出现，把散落的芥黄、焦橙、蓝灰、奶油色和低调橄榄色联系起来。边缘在撕裂般锐利与磨损般柔软之间交替；后涂颜料变薄之处露出底层。密集笔迹群被浅色露底空隙分开，表面因此活跃而不沦为均匀噪声。画中不需要具象光源，明度对比与颜料不透明度建立视觉层级。小中笔迹形成横长节奏，让注意力穿过层层肌理持续移动。
theme_en: An abstract field of layered black, ocher, orange, and blue-gray marks
theme_zh: 黑、赭黄、橙与蓝灰笔迹层叠构成的抽象画面
name: Abraham Rattner
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
